1	/**
     2	 * src/plugins/runner.ts
     3	 *
     4	 * Plugin runner — responsible for invoking plugin hooks in registration order.
     5	 *
     6	 * Each exported function corresponds to one lifecycle hook defined in
     7	 * PersonaBuildPlugin. The runner:
     8	 *   - Skips plugins that do not implement the requested hook (hook is optional)
     9	 *   - Invokes hooks in the order plugins are registered (first-in first-called)
    10	 *   - For accumulating hooks (onBuildContext, onPartials, onPersonaPartials,
    11	 *     onPostRender), each plugin receives the output of the previous plugin
    12	 *     as its first argument
    13	 *   - For collecting hooks (onValidate), results are concatenated into a
    14	 *     flat array
    15	 *
    16	 * No file-system I/O. No async operations.
    17	 */
    18	
    19	import type {
    20	  PersonaBuildPlugin,
    21	  PersonaMetadata,
    22	  SuiteConfig,
    23	  TargetType,
    24	  ValidationResult,
    25	} from './types.js';
    26	
    27	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    28	// Suite-level hook
    29	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    30	
    31	/**
    32	 * Invoke the `onSuiteInit` hook on every registered plugin.
    33	 *
    34	 * Each plugin may optionally implement this hook. Plugins are called in
    35	 * registration order. The hook receives the suite config and a mutable
    36	 * `sharedMeta` object — plugins may mutate `sharedMeta` in place; the
    37	 * same reference is passed to every subsequent plugin.
    38	 *
    39	 * @param plugins    Ordered list of registered plugins
    40	 * @param suite      The suite configuration object
    41	 * @param sharedMeta Mutable shared metadata object (mutated in place by plugins)
    42	 */
    43	export function runSuiteInit(
    44	  plugins: PersonaBuildPlugin[],
    45	  suite: SuiteConfig,
    46	  sharedMeta: Record<string, unknown>,
    47	): void {
    48	  for (const plugin of plugins) {
    49	    if (typeof plugin.onSuiteInit === 'function') {
    50	      plugin.onSuiteInit(suite, sharedMeta);
    51	    }
    52	  }
    53	}
    54	
    55	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    56	// Per-persona context accumulation
    57	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    58	
    59	/**
    60	 * Invoke the `onBuildContext` hook on every registered plugin, accumulating
    61	 * context mutations sequentially.
    62	 *
    63	 * Each plugin receives the context returned by the previous plugin. If a
    64	 * plugin does not implement `onBuildContext`, the context passes through
    65	 * unchanged. The final accumulated context is returned.
    66	 *
    67	 * @param plugins Ordered list of registered plugins
    68	 * @param ctx     Initial rendering context for this persona
    69	 * @param persona Typed metadata for the persona being built
    70	 * @param suite   The suite configuration object
    71	 * @param target  The current build target (optional — forwarded to each plugin)
    72	 * @returns       Accumulated rendering context after all plugins have run
    73	 */
    74	export function runBuildContext(
    75	  plugins: PersonaBuildPlugin[],
    76	  ctx: Record<string, unknown>,
    77	  persona: PersonaMetadata,
    78	  suite: SuiteConfig,
    79	  target?: TargetType,
    80	): Record<string, unknown> {
    81	  let accumulated = ctx;
    82	  for (const plugin of plugins) {
    83	    if (typeof plugin.onBuildContext === 'function') {
    84	      accumulated = plugin.onBuildContext(accumulated, persona, suite, target);
    85	    }
    86	  }
    87	  return accumulated;
    88	}
    89	
    90	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    91	// Per-persona post-render chain
    92	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    93	
    94	/**
    95	 * Invoke the `onPostRender` hook on every registered plugin, chaining the
    96	 * output string sequentially.
    97	 *
    98	 * Each plugin receives the string returned by the previous plugin. If a
    99	 * plugin does not implement `onPostRender`, the string passes through
   100	 * unchanged. The final string is returned.

101	 *
   102	 * @param plugins  Ordered list of registered plugins
   103	 * @param rendered Initial rendered output string
   104	 * @param persona  Typed metadata for the persona being built
   105	 * @param target   The current build target
   106	 * @returns        Final output string after all plugins have run
   107	 */
   108	export function runPostRender(
   109	  plugins: PersonaBuildPlugin[],
   110	  rendered: string,
   111	  persona: PersonaMetadata,
   112	  target: TargetType,
   113	): string {
   114	  let output = rendered;
   115	  for (const plugin of plugins) {
   116	    if (typeof plugin.onPostRender === 'function') {
   117	      output = plugin.onPostRender(output, persona, target);
   118	    }
   119	  }
   120	  return output;
   121	}
   122	
   123	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   124	// Suite-level partials accumulation
   125	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   126	
   127	/**
   128	 * Invoke the `onPartials` hook on every registered plugin, accumulating
   129	 * partials map mutations sequentially.
   130	 *
   131	 * Each plugin receives the partials map returned by the previous plugin. If a
   132	 * plugin does not implement `onPartials`, the map passes through unchanged.
   133	 * The final accumulated map is returned.
   134	 *
   135	 * Called once per suite after partials are loaded from disk, before any
   136	 * persona is rendered.
   137	 *
   138	 * @param plugins     Ordered list of registered plugins
   139	 * @param partialsMap Initial map of partial name → partial content
   140	 * @param suiteName   The identifier of the current suite
   141	 * @param suite       The suite configuration object
   142	 * @returns           Accumulated partials map after all plugins have run
   143	 */
   144	export function runPartials(
   145	  plugins: PersonaBuildPlugin[],
   146	  partialsMap: Record<string, string>,
   147	  suiteName: string,
   148	  suite: SuiteConfig,
   149	): Record<string, string> {
   150	  let accumulated = partialsMap;
   151	  for (const plugin of plugins) {
   152	    if (typeof plugin.onPartials === 'function') {
   153	      accumulated = plugin.onPartials(accumulated, suiteName, suite);
   154	    }
   155	  }
   156	  return accumulated;
   157	}
   158	
   159	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   160	// Per-persona partials accumulation
   161	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   162	
   163	/**
   164	 * Invoke the `onPersonaPartials` hook on every registered plugin, accumulating
   165	 * partials map mutations sequentially.
   166	 *
   167	 * Each plugin receives the partials map returned by the previous plugin. If a
   168	 * plugin does not implement `onPersonaPartials`, the map passes through
   169	 * unchanged. The final accumulated map is returned.
   170	 *
   171	 * Called for each persona (and target) after `onBuildContext`, before
   172	 * template rendering.
   173	 *
   174	 * @param plugins     Ordered list of registered plugins
   175	 * @param partialsMap Initial map of partial name → partial content
   176	 * @param persona     Typed metadata for the persona being built
   177	 * @param context     The rendering context built by `onBuildContext`
   178	 * @param suite       The suite configuration object
   179	 * @param target      The current build target (optional)
   180	 * @returns           Accumulated partials map after all plugins have run
   181	 */
   182	export function runPersonaPartials(
   183	  plugins: PersonaBuildPlugin[],
   184	  partialsMap: Record<string, string>,
   185	  persona: PersonaMetadata,
   186	  context: Record<string, unknown>,
   187	  suite: SuiteConfig,
   188	  target?: TargetType,
   189	): Record<string, string> {
   190	  let accumulated = partialsMap;
   191	  for (const plugin of plugins) {
   192	    if (typeof plugin.onPersonaPartials === 'function') {
   193	      accumulated = plugin.onPersonaPartials(accumulated, persona, context, suite, target);
   194	    }
   195	  }
   196	  return accumulated;
   197	}
   198	
   199	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   200	// Per-persona validation collection
   201	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   202	
   203	/**
   204	 * Invoke the `onValidate` hook on every registered plugin and collect all
   205	 * returned ValidationResult objects into a single flat array.
   206	 *
   207	 * Plugins that do not implement `onValidate` contribute nothing to the result.
   208	 * The return value is always an array (never null/undefined).
   209	 *
   210	 * @param plugins Ordered list of registered plugins
   211	 * @param persona Typed metadata for the persona being built
   212	 * @param suite   The suite configuration object
   213	 * @param target  The current build target (optional — forwarded to each plugin)
   214	 * @returns       Flat array of all ValidationResult objects from all plugins
   215	 */
   216	export function runValidate(
   217	  plugins: PersonaBuildPlugin[],
   218	  persona: PersonaMetadata,
   219	  suite: SuiteConfig,
   220	  target?: TargetType,
   221	): ValidationResult[] {
   222	  const results: ValidationResult[] = [];
   223	  for (const plugin of plugins) {
   224	    if (typeof plugin.onValidate === 'function') {
   225	      const pluginResults = plugin.onValidate(persona, suite, target);
   226	      results.push(...pluginResults);
   227	    }
   228	  }
   229	  return results;
   230	}
